cmd:
cat > /tmp/nginx_conf_patch.txt << 'EOF'
	##
	# Logging Settings
	##

	# Custom log format for benchmark
	log_format benchmark_format '$time_local - $request_method - $status - "$http_user_agent"';

	access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log;
EOF
cat /tmp/nginx_conf_patch.txt

sed -i '/access_log \/var\/log\/nginx\/access.log;/i\	# Custom log format for benchmark\n	log_format benchmark_format '\''$time_local - $request_method - $status - "$http_user_agent"'\'';\n' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
sed -i '/error_log \/var\/log\/nginx\/benchmark-error.log;/a\	# Rate limiting zone\n	limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=benchmark_limit:10m rate=10r/s;' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf

bash -c 'printf "%s\n" "server {" "    listen 8080;" "    server_name localhost;" "" "    root /var/www/html;" "    index index.html;" "" "    # Rate limiting" "    limit_req zone=benchmark_limit burst=10 nodelay;" "" "    # Logging" "    access_log /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log benchmark_format;" "    error_log /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log;" "" "    # Custom 404 page" "    error_page 404 /404.html;" "    location = /404.html {" "        internal;" "        root /var/www/html;" "    }" "" "    location / {" "        try_files \$uri \$uri/ =404;" "    }" "}"' > /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf
mkdir -p /var/www/html && echo "Welcome to the benchmark webserver" > /var/www/html/index.html && cat /var/www/html/index.html
mkdir -p /app/html && echo "Welcome to the benchmark webserver" > /app/html/index.html && cat /app/html/index.html
mkdir -p /app/html && echo "Page not found - Please check your URL" > /app/html/404.html && cat /app/html/404.html
service nginx start && service nginx status

echo "=== VERIFICATION ===" && echo "1. Nginx installed and running:" && service nginx status && echo "" && echo "2. Port 8080 listening:" && netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep 8080 || ss -tlnp | grep 8080 && echo "" && echo "3. Access log location:" && ls -la /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log && echo "" && echo "4. Error log location:" && ls -la /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log && echo "" && echo "5. Server config location:" && ls -la /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf && echo "" && echo "6. Default site removed:" && ls -la /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/ && echo "" && echo "7. Document root:" && ls -la /var/www/html/ && echo "" && echo "8. Index.html content:" && cat /var/www/html/index.html && echo "" && echo "9. 404.html content:" && cat /var/www/html/404.html && echo "" && echo "10. Test main page:" && curl -s http://localhost:8080/ && echo "" && echo "11. Test 404 page:" && curl -s http://localhost:8080/nonexistent && echo "" && echo "12. Access log content:" && cat /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log
